name: Hybrid Runbook Worker
short_description: A Hybrid Runbook Worker is a Windows or Linux machine, for example an on-premises server connected via Azure Arc, that runs Azure Automation runbooks locally with access to its own network and resources.

evidence.quote: That's where hybrid runbook workers come in
You install the runbook worker software on any machine, Windows or Linux
a hybrid worker from Azure Automation and Azure Arc there
ermöglichen Hybrid Runbook Worker die Ausführung dieser Skripte vor Ort oder auf einer dedizierten VM,
hybrid run book workers let you execute those scripts on premises or in a dedicated VM
